fact: On 19 May 2026 the Minister of National Education said the sector had digitised the various operations relating to schooling and to administrative and pedagogical management, in execution of the national digital transformation strategy launched by the President; the statement names no system, no level and no number of schools.
title: وزير التربية يشرف على انطلاق امتحان شهادة التعليم المتوسط دورة 2026 من ولاية الجلفة
